subject: Web Development
title: The Digital Divide
description: A quick win: understand The Digital Divide.

hook.text: Nearly three billion people still don't have internet access. The web isn't truly worldwide.

buildup.text: Infrastructure, cost, and literacy barriers keep billions offline in developing regions.

discovery.text: Projects like Starlink and undersea cables are expanding connectivity to remote areas.

twist.text: Access alone isn't enough. Affordable devices and digital literacy are equally critical.

climax.text: Closing the digital divide means building a web that works on the cheapest device and slowest link.

punchline.text: The web isn't global until everyone can use it.

quiz.question: How many people lack internet access?
